models.name: 2023 Honda Civic Si

sources.label: Honda 2023 Civic Si specifications and comparison

models.notes: 192 lb-ft and 2,952 lb converted to Nm and kg, rounded. Factory specification for the US Si.

models.name: 2024 Volkswagen Golf GTI

sources.label: Volkswagen Golf GTI MY2024 specification sheet

models.notes: 180 kW converted to mechanical hp. The source publishes 1,342 kg tare weight, which is not presented as curb weight. Passenger doors exclude the tailgate.

models.name: 2024 Toyota GR Corolla
models.notes: Circuit Edition: 3,268 lb curb weight and 273 lb-ft converted to kg and Nm. Passenger doors exclude the tailgate.

models.name: 2021 Mazda3 Turbo Sedan

sources.label: Mazda 2021 Mazda3 2.5 Turbo factory specification deck

models.notes: Premium-fuel rating: 250 hp and 320 lb-ft (434 Nm). Regular fuel: 227 hp and 310 lb-ft. Sedan curb weight 3,379 lb converted to 1,533 kg; length 183.5 in and wheelbase 107.3 in converted to millimeters. Game balance retains its original approximate mass.

models.name: 2022 Kia Forte GT Sedan
models.notes: GT automatic minimum curb weight: 3,012 lb; options increase weight. Torque 195 lb-ft converted to 264 Nm.

models.name: 1969 Ford Mustang Boss 302
models.notes: 290 hp is the period gross rating, not a modern SAE net measurement. The historical summary does not establish curb weight or torque for this exact car.

models.name: 2024 BMW M3 Competition
models.notes: 510 PS converted to mechanical hp. Weight uses DIN without driver; EU weight including the standard driver allowance is 1,805 kg.

models.name: 2024 Audi RS3 Sedan

sources.label: Audi RS 3 Sedan technical data, October 2023

models.notes: German-market 400 PS converted to mechanical hp. Unladen weight excludes driver. Regional power ratings differ; game balance retains its original rating.

models.name: 2024 Mercedes-AMG A45 S
models.notes: 421 PS converted to mechanical hp. Performance figures identify the A 45 S powertrain; exact 2024 curb weight is not confirmed. Passenger doors exclude the tailgate.

models.name: 1995 Mazda RX-7 Type R

sources.label: Toyota GAZOO historical Type R catalog, sold through March 1995

models.notes: Early-1995 Type R specification (August 1993 to March 1995 catalog period). 255 PS converted to mechanical hp. Two passenger doors; rear hatch excluded.

models.name: 2024 Porsche 911 Turbo S
models.notes: 650 PS converted to mechanical hp. Describes the non-hybrid 992.1 generation sold in 2024. Porsche publishes 1,640 kg unladen weight according to DIN for the Coupe; optional equipment can change actual weight.

models.name: 2024 Nissan GT-R Nismo

sources.label: Nissan 2024 GT-R press kit and specifications

models.notes: NISMO curb weight 3,867 lb and 481 lb-ft converted to kg and Nm. Premium fuel required for the factory performance rating.

models.name: 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Z06

sources.label: Chevrolet 2024 Corvette Z06 factory specification sheet

models.notes: 460 lb-ft converted to 624 Nm. Curb weight varies with options and is not confirmed in this specification sheet.

models.name: 1998 Toyota Supra RZ

sources.label: Toyota historical Supra RZ catalog, August 1997 to August 1999

models.notes: 280 PS converted to mechanical hp. This is the VVT-i RZ specification sold in 1998. Two passenger doors; rear hatch excluded.

models.name: 1999 Nissan Skyline GT-R V-Spec

sources.label: Toyota GAZOO historical 1999 Skyline GT-R V-spec catalog

models.notes: 280 PS converted to mechanical hp. Road-going V-spec, with period declared output.

models.name: 2024 Ferrari 296 GTB
models.notes: 830 CV combined system output converted to mechanical hp. Ferrari quotes 1,470 kg dry weight with optional lightweight content, not curb weight.

models.name: 2024 Lamborghini Revuelto
models.engine: 6.5L naturally aspirated V12 with three electric motors
models.notes: 1,015 CV combined system output converted to mechanical hp. The 725 Nm figure is for the combustion engine only. Published 1,772 kg is dry weight, not curb weight.

models.name: 2024 McLaren 750S
models.notes: 750 PS / 740 bhp. DIN kerb weight is 1,389 kg; the lighter 1,277 kg figure is dry weight.

models.name: 2024 Toyota RAV4 XLE AWD

sources.label: Toyota 2024 RAV4 eBrochure (engine, torque, transmission, seating, dimensions, grade curb weight)
Toyota USA Newsroom: 2024 RAV4 grades and AWD availability

models.notes: Toyota lists 203 hp and 184 lb-ft (249 Nm converted) for the 2.5L gas engine; published 8-speed automatic and AWD availability are from Toyota sources. Curb weight left null because the Toyota brochure grade value does not separate AWD. Length and wheelbase convert Toyota’s 180.9 in and 105.9 in. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Honda CR-V EX-L AWD 1.5T

sources.label: Honda 2024 CR-V feature guide by trim

models.notes: Honda lists EX-L 1.5T AWD at 190 SAE hp and 179 lb-ft (243 Nm), CVT, 3,635 lb (1,649 kg), 184.8 in length (4,694 mm), 106.3 in wheelbase (2,699 mm), 5 seats. Four passenger doors; tailgate excluded. CVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2024 Mazda CX-5 Turbo Premium AWD
models.notes: Official Mazda deck specifies the 2.5 Turbo Premium AWD, 256 SAE hp and 320 lb-ft on premium fuel (434 Nm converted), AWD, 6-speed automatic, 180.1-in length (4,575 mm), 106.2-in wheelbase (2,697 mm), five-passenger capacity. Mazda specification deck lists 3,867 lb (1,754 kg) for Turbo trims including Turbo Premium. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Subaru Forester Sport AWD
models.notes: Subaru brochure identifies the Sport 2.5L BOXER at 182 hp and base curb weight 3,538 lb (1,605 kg); official model dimensions are 182.7 in length (4,641 mm) and 105.1 in wheelbase (2,670 mm). Sport has standard Symmetrical AWD and Lineartronic CVT. Torque 176 lb-ft converted to 239 Nm. Four passenger doors; tailgate excluded. CVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2024 Kia Telluride SX AWD
models.notes: Kia lists a 3.8L GDI V6, 291 hp, 262 lb-ft (355 Nm converted), 8-speed automatic, SX AWD, 7 seats, 196.9-inch length (5,001 mm), 114.2-inch wheelbase (2,901 mm). Kia lists SX AWD curb weight at a minimum 4,301 lb (1,951 kg), with equipment-dependent range to 4,524 lb. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Hyundai Palisade Calligraphy AWD

sources.label: Hyundai 2024 Palisade specifications (manufacturer document archived by El Automovilista)

models.notes: Hyundai lists 291 hp and 262 lb-ft (355 Nm converted) for the 3.8L GDI V6; Calligraphy AWD uses an 8-speed automatic and seats seven. Length 196.7 in (4,996 mm) and wheelbase 114.2 in (2,901 mm). Exact curb weight remains unverified: the source gives a shared seven-seat AWD range of 4,389–4,506 lb without isolating Calligraphy. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Ford Explorer ST 4WD

sources.label: Ford Mexico 2024 Explorer ST specification catalogue

models.notes: Ford lists the 3.0L EcoBoost V6 at 400 hp and 415 lb-ft; torque converted to 563 Nm. ST 4WD uses a 10-speed automatic. Six seats with standard second-row captain chairs. Dimensions convert 198.8 in length and 119.1 in wheelbase. Curb weight left null because trim-specific value is not verified from a primary source. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 4WD 5.3 V8
models.engine: 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 with Dynamic Fuel Management

sources.label: GM 2024 Tahoe US retail/fleet order guide, archived copy (Z71 equipment and 5.3L 4WD specifications)

models.notes: 2024 Z71 4WD with standard 5.3L V8, 355 hp and 383 lb-ft (519 Nm converted), with ten-speed automatic. GM’s November 2023 order guide lists 2,568 kg (5,661 lb) curb weight for the 5.3L 4WD Tahoe; this is the shared powertrain/body figure, not an individually weighed Z71, and optional equipment changes weight. Z71 seats eight with the second-row bench, seven with optional buckets. Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon 3.6 automatic
models.notes: US 3.6L Pentastar V6 rating 285 SAE hp, 260 lb-ft (353 Nm converted); four-door Rubicon automatic uses 8-speed transmission and 4WD. Five seats. Length 188.4 in and wheelbase 118.4 in converted to mm. Curb weight left null because exact equipment/roof dependent figure was not verified. Four passenger doors; spare tire excluded.

models.name: 2024 Volvo XC90 B6 Plus AWD

sources.label: Volvo Cars archived 2024 XC90 technical document
Volvo Cars Cape Cod 2024 XC90 model and powertrain guide
Volvo MY24 XC90 Cyprus brochure (body dimensions reference; B5/T8 powertrains)

models.notes: 2024 US B6 mild-hybrid gasoline AWD has 295 SAE hp and 310 lb-ft (420 Nm converted), 8-speed automatic. XC90 Plus B6 is listed as seven-passenger configuration; exact US B6 Plus curb weight is not verified. The Cyprus brochure is used only for shared body dimensions, not B6 engine or weight figures. Length 195.0 in (4,953 mm), wheelbase 117.5 in (2,984 mm). Four passenger doors; liftgate excluded.

models.name: 2024 Toyota Camry SE FWD 2.5
models.notes: Toyota lists the gas SE FWD 2.5L at 203 hp and 184 lb-ft (249 Nm converted), with 8-speed automatic. Curb weight is 3,340 lb (1,515 kg), from the gas SE FWD column on page 24 of Toyota’s brochure; the paired 3,530 lb value is for AWD. Length 192.7 in (4,895 mm), wheelbase 111.2 in (2,824 mm). Five seats. Four passenger doors; trunk excluded.

models.name: 2024 Honda Accord EX 1.5T
models.notes: Honda lists EX 1.5L turbo at 192 SAE hp and 192 lb-ft (260 Nm converted), CVT, FWD, 3,280 lb (1,488 kg) curb weight, 195.7 in length (4,971 mm), 111.4 in wheelbase (2,830 mm), five seats. Regular unleaded. Four passenger doors; trunk excluded. CVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2024 Hyundai Elantra SEL 2.0

sources.label: Hyundai-authored 2024 Elantra specifications (facelift dimensions, archived PDF p.11)

models.notes: Hyundai lists the 2.0L SEL at 147 hp and 132 lb-ft (179 Nm converted), with Smartstream IVT and FWD. Length 185.4 in (4,709 mm; 2024 facelift), wheelbase 107.1 in (2,720 mm), five seats. Curb weight left null because Hyundai publishes a range shared across configurations. Four passenger doors; trunk excluded. IVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2024 Nissan Altima 2.5 SR FWD
models.notes: Nissan lists 2.5L FWD at 188 hp and 180 lb-ft (244 Nm converted), CVT, regular unleaded. Length 192.9 in (4,900 mm); wheelbase 111.2 in (2,824 mm). Five seats. Nissan’s factory table lists 3,323 lb (1,507 kg) total curb weight for 2.5 SR FWD. Four passenger doors; trunk excluded. CVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2024 Toyota Prius XLE FWD
models.engine: 2.0L Dynamic Force inline-4 with Toyota Hybrid System
models.notes: Toyota lists 194 net hp for FWD hybrid. Curb weight 3,164 lb (1,435 kg), five seats, 181.1-in length (4,600 mm), 108.3-in wheelbase (2,751 mm). Torque is the 2.0L engine-only 139 lb-ft (188 Nm converted); combined hybrid system torque is not specified. Four passenger doors; hatch excluded. eCVT has no fixed gear count.

models.name: 2019 Honda Fit Sport CVT
models.transmission: Continuously variable transmission (CVT) with paddle shifters

sources.label: Honda Canada 2019 Fit factory specification sheet, distributed by Harmony Honda

models.notes: Canadian Sport CVT specification: 128 SAE hp, 113 lb-ft (153 Nm), 1,184 kg curb weight, 4,100 mm length and 2,530 mm wheelbase. The manual variant has different output and weight. Regular gasoline; five seats. Four passenger doors; hatch excluded. CVT has no fixed gear count.
